ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white) to 25% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity (black) region concentrated around the median notch extending upwards along the interior trailing edges; lateral lobes are predominantly high-intensity (white) with irregular low-intensity spotting and dark bordering at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 70-80 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous boundary; prominent irregular jaggedness visible on the distal ends of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trailing edge exhibits a concave curve transitioning to a high-curvature convex sweep at the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark clusters observed on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal linear mark visible on the left lobe's mid-section; two smaller, faint linear marks visible on the right lobe's mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular indentations and minor tissue voids along the trailing edge, particularly visible on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy dark pigmentation flare at the center notch creating a butterfly-wing visual pattern against the white background.
